Hemant Soren's Emotional Tribute to Former Minister Sudivya Kumar Sonu

Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren posted an emotional tribute on X (formerly Twitter) following the cremation of former minister Sudivya Kumar Sonu. Soren described Sonu as someone who held the affection of an elder brother and the closeness of a friend, stating their relationship transcended mere titles. He expressed that while Sonu's physical form had been consigned to the elements, the memories of their time together would remain. The posts from both Prabhat Khabar and Navbharat Times focused on Soren's heartfelt message.
